title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
dek: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences.
body:
Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Nomas Estrellas en GitHub: 431

Hy-Nomas is a free-form interactive world generation model controlled by multi-turn text and camera inputs. It runs on a single RTX 4090 with low-memory inference, supports LoRA fine-tuning for downstream tasks, and includes an interactive web demo.
